newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-HAWKES LEADS AFTER LONG INJURY LAYOFF.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-HAWKES LEADS AFTER LONG INJURY LAYOFF.

text.p: South African Jeff Hawkes, back in regular golf after a long-term shoulder injury, snatched a one stroke halfway lead in the South African Players' championship on Friday.
The European Tour stalwart, out for 18 months, added a five-under-par 67 to his opening 68 for a nine-under-par total of 135.
Hawkes led four compatriots -- first round leader Richard Kaplan (70), Nico van Rensburg (69), Michael Green (66) and Andre Cruse (66).
Defending champion Wayne Westner of South Africa withdrew before the start of the second round with a back strain.
